description: KYNX v0.9.49 (Build 59) Mesh Networking Update: True Multi-Hop End-to-End Encrypted (E2EE) Mesh Grid. Communicate across unlimited hops (e.g. User 1 to User 100 via nodes 2-99) without internet or SIM. Intermediate nodes act as zero-knowledge relays and cannot decrypt or read content. Includes Public Campfire mesh broadcast room and live Multi-Hop Directory.
